title: Fitting the negative binomial
html:
In the NB2 model of @def-cnt-negbin with κ treated as a parameter:

  1. for fixed κ the distribution @eq-cnt-nb-pmf is an exponential dispersion family (@def-glm-edf) with natural parameter θ=log⁡{μ/(μ+κ)}, cumulant function b(θ)=−κlog⁡(1−eθ), dispersion ϕ=1 and variance function V(μ)=μ+μ2/κ;

  2. with the log link, the score for 𝛃β is 𝛃∂ℓ∂β=∑i=1nyi−μi1+μi/κx(i),{#eq-cnt-nb-score}

    so that Fisher scoring is iteratively reweighted least squares with weights wi=μi/(1+μi/κ), and the expected information for 𝛃β is X⊤WX;

  3. 𝛃β and κ are orthogonal: 𝛃E{∂2ℓ/∂β∂κ}=0, so the expected information is block diagonal and the two may be updated alternately. Under the usual regularity conditions for maximum likelihood this also makes the asymptotic distribution of 𝛃β^ the same whether κ is known or estimated (Cox and Reid 1987; not proved here);

  4. the score for κ is ∑i{ψ(yi+κ)−ψ(κ)+log⁡κκ+μi+1−κ+yiκ+μi}, where ψ is the digamma function; it has no closed-form root and is solved numerically;

  5. the Poisson model is the boundary case α=1/κ=0. The likelihood ratio statistic L for H0:α=0 is therefore not asymptotically χ2(1); under the conditions of Self and Liang (1987) its limiting distribution is 12χ2(0)+12χ2(1), so the p-value is Pr{N(0,1)>L}, half the naive one;

  6. in the NB1 model of @def-cnt-negbin(b), with κi=αμi and a log link, the score for 𝛃β at fixed α is 𝛃∂ℓ∂β=α∑i=1nμi{ψ(yi+αμi)−ψ(αμi)+log⁡α1+α}x(i).{#eq-cnt-nb1-score}

    The residual yi−μi does not appear, so this is not a weighted least squares equation at all. The quasi-Poisson model of Chapter 38 shares the NB1 variance function V(μ)=ϕμ but has the Poisson estimating equation 𝛍X⊤(y−μ)=0, so the two give different 𝛃β^ from the same data (@exr-cnt-quasi-vs-nb): a variance function does not determine a fit. Overdispersion is the rule rather than the exception, and modelling it changes the coefficients little and the standard errors a great deal; which of the three devices to use turns on whether a likelihood is needed, as it is for AIC and for Section 37.5.
